race.description: Cuprum Distillery - Vodka, Passionfruit & Soda Mdn
race.comment: CARTIER GLOW (7) has been in the money in his last 3 starts, following on from his debut fourth on this course in August. He likes to freewheel in front, and may have to work to find that regular spot this time from a tough gate. A 3kg claim will help, and he is still the one to beat. EXTREME RULER (1) is a 6YO maiden gelding peaking third up from a spell. He has been trying to win a race for some time, and gave a good sight for a long way when leading here nearly 4 weeks ago, finishing runner-up. He will also have a wide draw here, but can figure in the top 3 again. NICABOOM (11) had no luck in a couple of starts in good fields as a juvenile at Ascot off wide gates. She resumes and will appreciate drawing in this time. Expect something better in this. Keep safe. BASILICA BLISS (12) makes her debut after posting her best trial effort yet earlier in the month when finishing second. The blinkers are on, watch closely. HOWHIGHTHEMOON (10) is on debut, and not the worst for top 4 combos.
